```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggh4x)
```

load in relevant data frames for this analysis :
```{r}
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')


crypt_signature_attributions<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  group_by(biopsy)%>%
  mutate(biopsy_colibactin_pos=sum(SBS88>0 & ID18>0,na.rm=T)>1,     # both present in at least 2 crypts
         SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos=sum(SBS89>0 & ID25>0,na.rm=T)>1)%>%  # both present in at least 2 crypts
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%
  mutate(patient_colibactin_pos=(sum(biopsy_colibactin_pos,na.rm=T)>0),   # at least one biopsy positive
         patient_SBS89_ID25_pos=sum(SBS89_ID25_biopsy_pos,na.rm=T)>0)     # at least one biopsy positive
```

## a : summary statistics of exposures:
### i : summary statistics of prevalence
```{r}
# determine positive children
pos_patients=length(unique(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$patient_colibactin_pos==TRUE,]$patient))
all_patients=length(unique(crypt_signature_attributions$patient))
pos_biopsy=length(unique(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE,]$biopsy)) 
proportion_patients_positive<-round((pos_patients/all_patients)*100,digits=0) 

## state the results
print(paste0('Total number of patients : n=',all_patients))  # n=85 patients
print(paste0('Patients positive : n=',pos_patients))  # n=37 patients
print(paste0('Proportion of patients positive : ',proportion_patients_positive,"%"))  # n=37 patients
print(paste0('Biopsies positive : n=',pos_biopsy)) # n=48 biopsies
```
### ii : compare prevalence of colibactin by cohort :
compare prevalence of colibactin positive between ibd and normal individuals:
```{r}
cohort_sum_table<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%
  group_by(cohort,patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  summarise(patient = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = patient_colibactin_pos, values_from = patient, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cohort") %>%
  as.matrix()

## summarise by cohort :
cohort_sum_table
```

```{r}
## perform fishers test
fisher.test(cohort_sum_table)
```

```{r}
# fisher's test to compare between cohorts:
nationality_table <- left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%
  group_by(nationality,patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  summarise(patients = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = patient_colibactin_pos,
    values_from = patients,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop=`TRUE` / (`TRUE` + `FALSE`))%>%
  column_to_rownames("nationality") %>%
  as.matrix()

pvalue=round(fisher.test(nationality_table)$p.value,digits=4)
print(paste0("Fisher's p-value=",pvalue))
```

Provide a breakdown of positive biopsies by anatomical location
```{r}
## create a breakdown of positive biopsies by locaiton
donors_both_biopsies_df%>%
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  filter(!duplicated(biopsy))%>%
  select(patient, biopsy_colibactin_pos,location)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=location, values_from =biopsy_colibactin_pos)%>%
  mutate(sum=case_when(Sigmoid==TRUE & Ascending==TRUE ~'Both',
                       Sigmoid==TRUE & Ascending ==FALSE ~ 'Sigmoid',
                       Sigmoid==FALSE & Ascending ==TRUE ~ 'Ascending',
                       TRUE ~ 'Neither'))%>%
  group_by(sum)%>%
  summarise(n=length(sum))
```

### v: look at proportion of crypts that are positive in a given biopsy :
```{r}
crypts_biopsy_sum<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  mutate(crypt_colibactin_pos=(SBS88>0 & ID18>0))%>%
  group_by(biopsy)%>%
  summarise(n_positive_crypts=sum(crypt_colibactin_pos),
            n_crypts=n())%>%
  mutate(prop_crypts_positive=n_positive_crypts / n_crypts)%>%
  summarise(median_prop_pos=median(prop_crypts_positive), # median proportion of crypts pos (100%)
            median_count=median(n_positive_crypts), # median number of positive crypts per biopsy
            n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive=sum(prop_crypts_positive==1), # number of biopsies with 100% of crypts positive
            n_biopsies=n(), # number of biopsies
            lqr=quantile(prop_crypts_positive,0.25))

print(paste0('Median number of positive crypts per biopsy: ',crypts_biopsy_sum$median_count, ' crypts'))
print(paste0('Median proportion of positive crypts per biopsy : ',crypts_biopsy_sum$median_prop_pos*100, '%'))
print(paste0('Number of biopsies with all crypts positive : ',crypts_biopsy_sum$n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive, ' biopsies'))
print(paste0('Total number of positive biopsies : ',crypts_biopsy_sum$n_biopsies, ' biopsies'))
```

### ii : perform comparisons by biopsy location :
```{r}
# filter for location :
location_df <- left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  mutate(SBS88=SBS88/sensitivitySBS,ID18=ID18/sensitivityID)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0& biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>% # subset positive crypts
  select(patient, crypt,site,SBS88,ID18)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),values_to='count','names_to'='signature')
sigs <- c("SBS88", "ID18")

# Function to fit model comparing left to right colon and extract stats :
fit_location_model <- function(sig, data) {
  model <- lmer(count ~ site + (1 | patient), data = filter(data, signature == sig))
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   # site comparison term
    mutate(
      signature = sig, estimate = round(estimate, 0), 
      low_ci = round(estimate - 1.96 * std.error, 0), 
      upp_ci = round(estimate + 1.96 * std.error, 0), p.value = round(p.value, 10)) %>%
    select(signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci, p.value)
}

# Run models
location_results <- map_dfr(sigs, fit_location_model, data = location_df)
location_results %>%
  mutate(text = paste0(signature, ": ", abs(estimate), " [", abs(upp_ci), ", ", abs(low_ci), "] P=", p.value,'\n')) %>%
  pull(text) %>%
  walk(cat)
```
### iii : perform comparisons by IBD and normal individuals :
```{r}
# filter for location :
ibd_normal_df <- left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  mutate(SBS88=SBS88/sensitivitySBS,ID18=ID18/sensitivityID)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0& biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>% # subset positive crypts
  select(patient, crypt,site,cohort,SBS88,ID18)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),values_to='count','names_to'='signature')
sigs <- c("SBS88", "ID18")

# Function to fit model and extract stats
fit_cohort_model <- function(sig, data) {
  model <- lmer(count ~ site +cohort+ (1 | patient), data = filter(data, signature == sig))
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "cohortNormal") %>%   # site comparison term
    mutate(
      signature = sig, estimate = round(estimate, 0), 
      low_ci = round(estimate - 1.96 * std.error, 0), 
      upp_ci = round(estimate + 1.96 * std.error, 0), p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
    select(signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci, p.value)
}

# Run models
ibd_normal_results <- map_dfr(sigs, fit_cohort_model, data = ibd_normal_df)
ibd_normal_results %>%
  mutate(text = paste0(signature, ": ", (estimate), " [", (upp_ci), ", ", (low_ci), "] P=", p.value,'\n')) %>%
  pull(text) %>%
  walk(cat)
```
### iv : compare children, adults and tumour crypts :
read in data from lee-six et al. Nature. 2019
```{r}
## Lee Six et al Nature 2019 attributions : Taken from Supplementary Table of paper
hls_metadata <- read.csv('..//Data/Lee_Six_Nature_2019/41586_2019_1672_MOESM4_ESM.csv')
hls_attributions <- read.table('../Data/Lee_Six_Nature_2019/41586_2019_1672_MOESM5_ESM.txt',sep='\t',header=T)

hls_attributions <- left_join(hls_attributions,hls_metadata,by=c('patient'='patient_label_in_files','age','sex'))%>%
  
  # subset for just adults :
  filter(age>18)%>%

  # format variables to facilitate analyses :
  mutate(tumour_normal_status='Normal Adult', # this will be the grouping parameter for downstream comparisons
         location=case_when(str_detect(site, 'Left') ~ 'Left Sided Colon',
                            TRUE~'Right Sided Colon'),
         tissue_strat=paste0(tumour_normal_status,' ',location),
         crypt='Normal Adult',
         colibactin_present=ifelse((SBSA>100 | SBSA/sbstotal>0.05) & (IDA>5 | IDA/idtotal>0.05),TRUE,FALSE))%>% # use crtierion from Lee Six paper 
  
  # subset for just colibactin positive crypts
  filter(colibactin_present==TRUE)%>%
  dplyr::select(crypt,age,location,tumour_normal_status,tissue_strat,SBSA,IDA)
colnames(hls_attributions)<-c('crypt','age','site','tumour_normal','tissue_strat','SBS88','ID18')
```

read in tumour data from Diaz-Gay et al. Nature 2025
```{r}
## Read in data from Diaz-Gay et al. Nature 2025 : Metadata is not publically available
mutographs_tumour_metadata<-read_excel('../Data/Diaz_Gay_Nature_2025/MutWP1_CRC_tumour_specific_Manuscript_v2_2.xlsx')%>%
  select(donor_id,tumorsite)

# read in Diaz-Gay et al. Nature Metadata 2025:  Metadata is not publically available
mutographs_metadata<-read_excel('../Data/Diaz_Gay_Nature_2025/MutWP1_CRC_core_data_Manuscript_v2.xlsx')%>%
  select(donor_id,age_diag, cancer_type)%>%
  left_join(mutographs_tumour_metadata,'donor_id')%>%
  mutate(location=case_when(str_detect(tumorsite, 'Left|Sigmoid|sigmoid|Splenic') ~ 'Left Sided Colon',TRUE~'Right Sided Colon'))%>%
  select(donor_id,age_diag,location)

# read in SBS attribution from Diaz-Gay et al. Nature 2025
mutographs_sbs_attributions<-read_excel('../Data/Diaz_Gay_Nature_2025/41586_2025_9025_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx',sheet='Supplementary Table 11',skip=2)

# read in ID attribution from Diaz-Gay et al. Nature 2025
mutographs_id_attributions<-read_excel('../Data/Diaz_Gay_Nature_2025/41586_2025_9025_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx',sheet='Supplementary Table 12',skip=2)
mutographs_id_attributions<-mutographs_id_attributions%>%filter(ID18>0)%>%select(Sample,ID18)


mutographs_attributions_df <- mutographs_metadata%>%
  left_join(mutographs_sbs_attributions,by=c('donor_id'='Sample'))%>%
  left_join(mutographs_id_attributions,by=c('donor_id'='Sample'))%>%
  filter(ID18>0 | SBS88 >0)%>%
  mutate(tumour_normal = "Tumour",age_diag=median(age_diag), Sample="Tumour", tissue_strat = paste0(tumour_normal,' ',location))%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample,age_diag,location,tumour_normal,tissue_strat,SBS88,ID18)

colnames(mutographs_attributions_df)<-c('Sample','age','site','tumour_normal','tissue_strat','SBS88','ID18')
```

reformat children's crypts burdens for analysis 
```{r}
## derive summaries per donor
mutographs_compare<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  
  # adjust for sensitivity scores 
  mutate(SBS88=SBS88/sensitivitySBS,ID18=ID18/sensitivityID)%>%
  
  # subset just positive crypts
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0& biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>% # subset positive crypts
  mutate(site=paste0(site,' Sided Colon'), tumour_normal='Normal', tissue_strat = paste0(tumour_normal, ' ',site))%>%
  select(patient,age,site,tumour_normal,tissue_strat,SBS88,ID18)

colnames(mutographs_compare)<-c('crypt','age','site','tumour_normal','tissue_strat','SBS88','ID18')
  
```

combine to construct a master datafame for analysis and for plotting
```{r}
## construct a combined dataframe to facilitate plotting :
mutographs_compare_df<-rbind(mutographs_compare,mutographs_attributions_df, hls_attributions)%>%
  
  # convert to long format to facilitate plotting
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),values_to='count',names_to='signature')%>%
  
  # select only cases with positive burdens for SBS88 / ID18 
  filter(count>0)%>%
  
  # stipulate factor levels
  mutate(site=factor(site,levels=c('Left Sided Colon','Right Sided Colon')),
         tissue_strat=ifelse(tissue_strat=='Tumour',paste0(tissue_strat,' ',location),tissue_strat),
         signature=factor(signature,levels=c('SBS88','ID18')))
```

### v. compare between paediatric crypts and normal adult crypts:
```{r}
## run linear mixed effects for children versus adult with stratification by site
compare_children_adult <- mutographs_compare_df[!str_detect(mutographs_compare_df$tissue_strat,'Tumour'),] %>%
  group_by(site, signature) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lmer(count ~ tissue_strat + (1 | Sample), data = .x)
    broom.mixed::tidy(model)})%>%
  filter(effect=='fixed' & term!='(Intercept)')

# obtain model estimates
estimate=round(compare_children_adult$estimate,digits=0)
upper_ci=round(compare_children_adult$estimate+1.96*compare_children_adult$std.error,digits=0)
lower_ci=round(compare_children_adult$estimate-1.96*compare_children_adult$std.error,digits=0)
compare_children_adult$sum=paste0(estimate,' [',lower_ci,',',upper_ci,']')
compare_children_adult$p.value=round(compare_children_adult$p.value,digits=3)
compare_children_adult$comparison='children adult'


compare_children_adult<-compare_children_adult%>%
  select(signature,site, comparison,sum,p.value)
```

```{r}
lee_six_2019_prevalence
```

```{r}
# create summary table for children:
childre_prevalence<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%
  group_by(patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  summarise(children = n(), .groups = "drop")%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='patient_colibactin_pos')
```

### vi : compare between children and tumours:
```{r}
## because all tumours are one individual, we fit just a linear model :
compare_children_tumours<-mutographs_compare_df[!str_detect(mutographs_compare_df$tissue_strat,'Normal Adult'),]%>%
  group_by(site, signature) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lm(count ~ tissue_strat, data = .x)
    broom.mixed::tidy(model)})%>%
  filter(term!='(Intercept)')%>%
  mutate(sum=paste0(abs(round(estimate,digits=0)),' [', abs(round(estimate+1.96*std.error,digits=0)),',',abs(round(estimate-1.96*std.error,digits=0)),']'),
                    p.value=round(p.value,digits=3),
         comparison='children tumour')%>%
  select(site,comparison, sum,p.value)
```

create an aggregate dataframe for plotting 
```{r}
## for comparison between children's locations, format the previous comparisons betwen locations:
children_site_compare<-location_results
children_site_compare$site='Left Right Colon'
children_site_compare$comparison='children children'
children_site_compare$signature=str_remove(children_site_compare$signature,'\\s')

children_site_compare<-children_site_compare%>%
  select(signature,site, comparison, p.value)

# createa a combined dataframe
compare_p_values_df<-rbind(compare_children_adult,compare_children_tumours,children_site_compare)%>%
  group_by(signature) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),digits=3))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(label=case_when(p.adj<0.001~'P < 0.001',
                         TRUE~paste0('P = ',round(p.adj,digits=3))),
         comparison=factor(comparison,levels=c('children children','children tumour','children adult')))%>%
  arrange(signature, site, comparison)

```

##c : Figure 2.C : Boxplot for each individual biopsy in children's cohort
```{r}
svg('~/cohort_crypt_summary.svg',,width=17,height=8, bg='transparent')
## initialise plot :
ggplot(mutographs_compare_df, aes(x = fct_reorder(crypt,age), y = count, fill = tissue_strat)) +
  
  # create boxplot :
  geom_boxplot(size = 0.7) +
  
  # facet plot by signature and by colon side
  facet_grid(signature~ site, scales = "free", space = "free_x", switch='both',
              label=labeller(site=as_labeller(c(`Left Sided Colon` = 'Colon Left Side',`Right Sided Colon` = 'Colon Right Side')),
                             signature=as_labeller(c(SBS88='SBS88 Mutation Burden', ID18='ID18 Mutation Burden')))) +
   facetted_pos_scales(y = list(signature == "SBS88" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2750)), TRUE ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 750)))) +
  
  # stipulate colour scheme :
  scale_fill_manual(breaks=c("Normal Left Sided Colon","Normal Right Sided Colon","Normal Adult Right Sided Colon", "Normal Adult Left Sided Colon","Tumour Left Sided Colon", "Tumour Right Sided Colon"),
                    values = c('thistle1','thistle1','orchid3','orchid3', 'orchid4','orchid4'),
                    labels=c("Child Colon", "",'Adult Colon','','Colorectal Tumour','')) +
   

  # formate labels and theme :  
  labs(fill = 'crypt Type') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom',
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement='outside'
  )
dev.off()
```

```{r}
ggplot(mutographs_compare_df, aes(x = tissue_strat, y = count, fill = tissue_strat)) +
  
  # construct boxplot :
  geom_boxplot(size = 0.7,outlier=F) +
  
  # fcet by signature :
  facet_grid(signature~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_x", switch='y',
             label=labeller(signature=as_labeller(c(SBS88='SBS88 Mutation Burden',  ID18='ID18 Mutation Burden')))) +
   facetted_pos_scales(y = list(signature == "SBS88" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4000)), TRUE ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,600)))) +
  
  # stipulate colour scheme
  scale_fill_manual(values =c('thistle1','orchid3', 'orchid4','thistle1','orchid3', 'orchid4')) +
  
  # add in brakces and pvalues :
  geom_segment(data = brackets_df, aes(x = xstart, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets_df, aes(x = xstart, xend = xstart, y = y, yend = 0.98*y),  inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets_df,  aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y, yend = 0.98*y), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
  
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y *1.05, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  
  # stipulate x axis :
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c('Normal Left Sided Colon','Normal Adult Left Sided Colon',"Tumour Left Sided Colon",
                            'Normal Right Sided Colon','Normal Adult Right Sided Colon',"Tumour Right Sided Colon"),
                   labels=c('Childhood Colon\nLeft Side', 'Adult Colon\nLeft Side','Colorectal Cancer\nLeft Side',
                            'Childhood Colon\nRight Side','Adult Colon\nRight Side','Colorectal Cancer\nRight Side'))+
  
  # formate theme 
  labs(fill = 'crypt Type') +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14,face='bold'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'none',
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement='outside',
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )
dev.off()
```
